verdicts.decision_note: The client unambiguously accepts the immediately preceding proposal to add battery protection and a third NTC safety terminal to the Power Board.
The client specifies AXP2101 overcharge and overdischarge cutoff behavior and confirms that the battery NTC input must be placed on J_BAT; no obsolete key remains after replay.
The client accepts the immediately preceding clarification that the battery protection design must include thermal protection.
